mapper.sql: select e.edge_id, e.subject_id, e.from_knowledge_id, e.to_knowledge_id, e.relation, e.weight, e.status, e.create_by, e.create_time, e.update_by, e.update_time, e.remark, kf.knowledge_name as from_knowledge_name, kt.knowledge_name as to_knowledge_name, s.subject_name from spas_knowledge_edge e left join spas_knowledge kf on kf.knowledge_id = e.from_knowledge_id left join spas_knowledge kt on kt.knowledge_id = e.to_knowledge_id left join spas_subject s on s.subject_id = e.subject_id
mapper.insert: insert into spas_knowledge_edge( subject_id, from_knowledge_id, to_knowledge_id, relation, weight, status, remark, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{subjectId}, #{fromKnowledgeId}, #{toKnowledgeId}, #{relation}, #{weight}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, now() )
mapper.delete: delete from spas_knowledge_edge where from_knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId} or to_knowledge_id = #{knowledgeId}
